channel.title: Confused Catholic
channel.description: Scripture and Sacrament are the two most debated topics in all of religion. Here at the Confused Catholic, we provide resources and reflections for people looking to live Christian lives in today's world.

item.title: Inheriting my dad's Bible
item.description: God works in mysterious ways. I inherited my dad's Bible seven years after his death. This is that story.

item.title: My name is David: I cry out to God in the night.
item.description: When I made my way back to the Church, I adopted a new prayer routine. It's tiring. It's arguably rote. Yet, I don't stop.

item.title: My name is Jacob: I build idols and wander the desert.
item.description: A personal testimony on fatherhood, lineage and legacy.

item.title: The prophecy of the priest
item.description: This is not an attempt to condemn them nor to call anybody out. This is my witness of two lives unfolding over decades. There is no single great act of treachery in this story. Just a slow accumulation of deferral and miscommunication. This couple is still together. I wish them the best in life. I do not want others to suffer the way this couple has.

item.title: Waking inside the Garden
item.description: I went to sleep. I woke up in a primordial world. Like nothing I've ever seen before.

item.title: What does Sola Scriptura mean?
item.description: Sola Scriptura. Scripture alone. Many people use this to describe their faith. Here, we take a look at what that actually means and why its practical implementation is impossible without Divine Assistance.
